subject.title: fix(repair): publish only validated target commits

question: Should repair execution adopt this Linux namespace and Landlock boundary as a mandatory fail-closed runner contract once exact-head hosted proof passes?
rationale: The patch deliberately trades compatibility and repair availability on unsupported runners for a stronger credential and publication boundary; tests cannot choose that operational security policy.

options.title: Require the hardened boundary
options.body: Accept the Linux-only contract after exact-head hosted proof demonstrates immutable publication, containment, descendant reaping, and clear unsupported-runner failure.

options.title: Preserve broader runner compatibility
options.body: Keep the PR open and redesign the workflow so unsupported runners retain a separately approved safe path without weakening publication isolation.

options.title: Pause the expansion
options.body: Close or narrow the draft if the infrastructure and maintenance cost of the new containment runtime outweighs the repair-lane benefit.

recommendation.title: Require the hardened boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the Linux-only contract after exact-head hosted proof demonstrates immutable publication, containment, descendant reaping, and clear unsupported-runner failure.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current containment design and the related superseded repair-hardening branch, making them the strongest available implementation and operational context owner.
